description: Four-exercise partial-view review pack, using the existing scenario/engine/browser/video loop.
limitations: Synthetic observation changes test counting and presentation rules, not how MediaPipe detects a genuinely cropped body. No camera footage or new acoustic capture is supplied by this pack.

Leg Raise ankle loss: pause/no-false-rep checks are a safety baseline, NOT a solution to the missed-rep usability problem. A thigh-based driver still requires independently reviewed positive and negative camera evidence.
Plank ankle loss: withheld time and null form are a safety baseline, NOT successful partial-view hold recognition. No unseen lower-body alignment is inferred.

The September recording/diagnostic review is reused as symptom provenance, not relabelled as clean-camera replay: its retained exercise landmarks are Side Plank only. See docs/sessions/current-recording-review-2026-09-07.md.

Browser runs use Building tier at desktop/narrow widths. The companion regression suite replays the same scenarios across all nine supported exercise-tier pairs. Neither establishes beginner comprehension or physical-phone performance.
